हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Superstar singer Raj Mathur ka life tab badal jaata hai jab uski girlfriend Julie usse dhoka deti hai, aur heartbroken hoke woh red-light area mein Rani se milta hai - ek prostitute jisme singing ka hidden talent hai.  Contract marriage se shuru hoke real love tak ka ye journey hai, lekin jab Raj ki jealous billionaire music producer Shanaya ko pata chalta hai, toh woh Rani ko kidnap karke torture karti hai - kya Raj apni pregnant wife Rani ko bacha payega aur Shanaya se badla le payega?
